name: SRE · etcd without leader · 1m
description: Checks etcd without leader · 1m. Values are evaluated every 60 seconds. Windows apply to observed samples; inspect collection health before interpreting a missing result. Thresholds are starting points to review against the workload baseline.
remediation:
1. Identify the cluster and node in the title. Check etcd quorum and peer connectivity.
2. Compare leader changes, WAL writes, database commits, peer round trips, pod restarts and previous logs at the same time.
3. Preserve snapshots before recovery. Never remove a member or restore a snapshot based on this alert alone.

name: SRE · missing node OS telemetry · 5m
query: min_over_time((((max by (cluster_name,node) (kubernetes_state_node_age) * 0 + 1) unless on (cluster_name,node) (max by (cluster_name,node) (up{job="sre-node"} == 1))) or on (cluster_name,node) (max by (cluster_name,node) (kubernetes_state_node_age) * 0))[5m:30s])
description: Checks missing node OS telemetry · 5m. Values are evaluated every 60 seconds. Windows apply to observed samples; inspect collection health before interpreting a missing result. Thresholds are starting points to review against the workload baseline.
remediation:
1. Check the collector pod, readiness, recent and previous logs.
2. Verify DNS, TLS, NetworkPolicy, endpoint reachability, ingestion credentials and remote-write responses.
3. Check queue growth and dropped samples. A running pod does not prove successful delivery.

name: SRE · PVC filesystem below 10 percent available · 15m
query: max_over_time(((max by (cluster_name,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim) (kubernetes_kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes) / max by (cluster_name,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim) (kubernetes_kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes)) and on (cluster_name,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim) (max by (cluster_name,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim) (kubernetes_kubelet_volume_stats_inodes) > 0))[15m:30s])
titleTemplate: SRE · PVC filesystem below 10 percent available · 15m · ${cluster_name} · ${namespace} · ${persistentvolumeclaim}
description: Checks PVC filesystem below 10 percent available · 15m. Values are evaluated every 60 seconds. Windows apply to observed samples; inspect collection health before interpreting a missing result. Thresholds are starting points to review against the workload baseline.
remediation:
1. Locate the named cluster, namespace and PVC. Check available bytes and recent growth inside the mounted filesystem.
2. Verify snapshots, retention, application writes and StorageClass expansion support.
3. Forecasts are trends, not guarantees; compare several time windows before resizing or deleting data.

name: SRE · Traefik certificate expires within 30 days
titleTemplate: SRE · Traefik certificate expires within 30 days · ${cluster_name} · ${namespace} · ${sans} · ${serial}
description: Checks Traefik certificate expires within 30 days. Values are evaluated every 60 seconds. Windows apply to observed samples; inspect collection health before interpreting a missing result. Thresholds are starting points to review against the workload baseline.
remediation:
1. Read the certificate SANs and serial number in the title. The observed value is days remaining; a negative value means expired.
2. Check the issuing controller, Ingress Secret and renewal errors.
3. Confirm the renewed certificate is actually served by every Traefik replica.

name: SRE · host disk response above 20ms · 10m
description: Average disk response exceeds 20 ms throughout observed samples in a 10-minute window, while the five-minute average activity is at least 1 operation/s. This is an initial investigation threshold, not a universal storage SLA.
remediation: Identify node and device. Compare disk response, operations in progress, workload IOPS and storage backend health. Check the same time window for application latency. Do not reboot, replace a disk or delete data based only on this threshold.

name: SRE · VM CPU scheduler wait above 10 percent · 10m
titleTemplate: SRE · VM CPU scheduler wait above 10 percent · 10m · ${cluster_name} · ${namespace} · ${name}
description: Each virtual CPU spends more than 10% of wall time, on average, waiting to run on a host CPU throughout observed samples in 10 minutes. KubeVirt scheduler delay is not automatically the VMware CPU Ready counter. Health is attached to the Harvester host; the title identifies the VM.
remediation: Check the named VM and its Harvester host. Compare host CPU busy, VM CPU consumption, allocation and competing VMs. Review scheduling and overcommit. Adjust the baseline to the workload before paging.

name: SRE · VM disk response above 20ms · 10m
query: min_over_time((((max by(k8s_cluster_name,namespace,name,drive) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_read_times_seconds_total{drive!~".*(cloudinit|cdrom).*"}[5m]))+max by(k8s_cluster_name,namespace,name,drive) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_write_times_seconds_total{drive!~".*(cloudinit|cdrom).*"}[5m])))/((max by(k8s_cluster_name,namespace,name,drive) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_iops_read_total{drive!~".*(cloudinit|cdrom).*"}[5m]))+max by(k8s_cluster_name,namespace,name,drive) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_iops_write_total{drive!~".*(cloudinit|cdrom).*"}[5m]))) >= 1))*1000 * on(k8s_cluster_name,namespace,name) group_left(cluster_name,node) (label_replace(max by(k8s_cluster_name,namespace,name,node) (kubevirt_vmi_info{phase="running"}), "cluster_name", "$1", "k8s_cluster_name", "(.*)")))[10m:30s])
description: Combined virtual disk read/write response exceeds 20 ms over observed 10-minute samples with at least 1 operation/s. Idle and cloud-init disks are excluded. This initial threshold needs a workload baseline. Health is attached to the host; the title identifies VM and drive.
remediation: Compare VM read/write times and IOPS with host disk response, queues and Longhorn volume/replica health. Check guest load and snapshots at the same time. This does not identify the faulty physical disk by itself.

name: SRE · Traefik HTTP 5xx above 5 percent · 5m
query: min_over_time(((((sum by(cluster_name,service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{protocol="http",code=~"5.."}[5m]))) or on(cluster_name,service) (0 * (sum by(cluster_name,service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{protocol="http"}[5m])))))/(sum by(cluster_name,service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{protocol="http"}[5m])) >= 100)) * on(cluster_name,service) group_left(namespace,backend) (max by(cluster_name,namespace,service,backend) (label_replace(sre_ingress_backend_info{ingress_namespace!=""}, "namespace", "$1", "ingress_namespace", "(.*)"))))[5m:30s])
description: More than 5% of completed requests fail with HTTP 5xx, with at least 100 requests in each observed five-minute calculation window. The condition must persist over observed samples for five minutes. Uses Traefik counters, not span sampling.
remediation: Open the HTTP 5xx timeline and identify application, code and time. Correlate Traefik access logs and application traces/logs. Check readiness, dependencies and recent deployments. Do not treat expected 4xx responses as server failures.

name: SRE · Traefik p95 response above 3s · 10m
query: min_over_time((((histogram_quantile(0.95,sum by(cluster_name,service,le) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{protocol="http"}[5m])))) and on(cluster_name,service) (sum by(cluster_name,service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{protocol="http"}[5m])) >= 100)) * on(cluster_name,service) group_left(namespace,backend) (max by(cluster_name,namespace,service,backend) (label_replace(sre_ingress_backend_info{ingress_namespace!=""}, "namespace", "$1", "ingress_namespace", "(.*)"))))[10m:30s])
description: The estimated 95th-percentile response time exceeds 3 seconds. This means the boundary below which about 95% of requests finish is above 3 seconds; it does not mean 95% of requests take longer than 3 seconds. Requires at least 100 requests per five-minute calculation window, persisting over observed samples for ten minutes. Replace this starting threshold with the service objective.
remediation: Compare slow and successful/error requests, backend latency, host/Pod saturation and dependencies. Exclude or separately baseline streaming and long-polling APIs when required. Compare the same time interval.

name: SRE · instrumented app HTTP 5xx above 5 percent · 5m
query: min_over_time((((sum by(cluster_name,namespace,service_name) (increase(http_server_requests_total{http_response_status_code=~"5..",http_route!~"(?i).*(health|ready|live|metrics).*"}[5m]))) or on(cluster_name,namespace,service_name) (0 * (sum by(cluster_name,namespace,service_name) (increase(http_server_requests_total{http_route!~"(?i).*(health|ready|live|metrics).*"}[5m])))))/(sum by(cluster_name,namespace,service_name) (increase(http_server_requests_total{http_route!~"(?i).*(health|ready|live|metrics).*"}[5m])) >= 100))[5m:30s])
titleTemplate: SRE · instrumented app HTTP 5xx above 5 percent · 5m · ${cluster_name} · ${namespace} · ${service_name}
description: Uses application counters: 5xx exceeds 5% with at least 100 calls per five-minute window, over observed samples for five minutes. Health attaches to the Kubernetes namespace because the instrumented service name may differ from its Kubernetes Service name.
remediation: Identify the application and route in Instrumented apps. Correlate the spike with application exceptions and dependency traces. Review the service objective and avoid duplicate notification routes when native HTTP/span monitors already cover the same incident.

name: SRE · instrumented app p95 above 3s · 10m
description: Application p95 response time exceeds 3 seconds with at least 100 calls per five-minute calculation window, over observed samples for ten minutes. Health attaches to the namespace; the title identifies the application.
remediation: Check route latency, errors, recent deployments and dependency traces. Three seconds is an initial baseline only; use the application service objective. Compare measurements from the client, proxy and application separately.

name: SRE · VM filesystem above 90 percent used · 15m
titleTemplate: SRE · VM filesystem above 90 percent used · ${cluster_name} · ${namespace} · ${name} · ${disk_name}
description: A filesystem reported by the VM guest agent remains above 90% used throughout observed samples over 15 minutes. Excludes temporary, boot, runtime and loop filesystems. Missing guest data does not imply free space. Health attaches to the host; the title identifies the VM and disk. Bind mounts of the same guest device are counted once.
remediation: Check free space inside the named VM filesystem, growth, logs and retention. Compare guest filesystem capacity with its virtual disk and Longhorn volume. Expand only through the supported storage and guest-filesystem process. Do not delete files automatically.

name: SRE · Virtualization metrics scrape failing · 3m
description: An observed KubeVirt or Longhorn target has no successful scrape in the last three minutes. Check target discovery separately when a target disappears.
remediation: Check collector logs, current KubeVirt CA, target TLS names, API discovery RBAC and internal endpoint access. Refresh the copied public CA after rotation and upgrade the module. Never disable certificate validation.

name: SRE · Longhorn volume degraded · 5m
description: Longhorn reports the volume as degraded throughout observed samples in 5m. Evaluated every minute. Only volumes with PVC identity are attached to topology; other volumes remain visible in Storage & Backups. Missing telemetry is not healthy.
remediation: Open Storage & Backups and identify the named PVC and Longhorn volume. Inspect replica health, scheduling conditions, free disk space and node availability in Longhorn. Check the affected workload before repair. Do not delete the volume or replicas based only on this alert.

name: SRE · Longhorn volume faulted · 1m
description: Longhorn reports the volume as faulted throughout observed samples in 1m. Evaluated every minute. Only volumes with PVC identity are attached to topology; other volumes remain visible in Storage & Backups. Missing telemetry is not healthy.
remediation: Open Storage & Backups and identify the named PVC and Longhorn volume. Inspect replica health, scheduling conditions, free disk space and node availability in Longhorn. Check the affected workload before repair. Do not delete the volume or replicas based only on this alert.

name: SRE · VMware import failed or invalid · 5m
titleTemplate: SRE · VMware import failed or invalid · 5m · ${cluster_name} · ${namespace}/${import_name} · ${phase}
description: A retained VM Import Controller record reports failure or invalid input for 5 minutes of observed samples. The event is attached to its namespace; the title identifies the import. Historical failed records stay alerting until handled. Missing inventory is not a healthy zero.
remediation: Inspect the named VirtualMachineImport, its conditions and controller logs. Check source access, disk image preparation, storage and target VM events. Verify whether the record is current before retrying; retrying can have workload side effects. Do not delete the record just to clear the alert.

name: SRE · VMware import inventory unavailable · 3m
description: The inventory collector reports unsuccessful or stale reads for 3 minutes of observed samples. A completely missing collector produces no series; also check the official Agent workload health. No successful import is inferred from absent data.
remediation: Check the obs-imports-imports workload, import-inventory logs, VM Import Controller CRD and read permissions. Check metric delivery and the ingestion Secret without printing its value. No VMware login or new import is needed to repair inventory.

name: SRE · Import performance collection failing · 3m
description: An observed kubelet target failed performance collection for 3 minutes. Applies only when imports.performance.enabled is true. Disabled collection or disappeared discovery has no series and is not evaluated as healthy.
remediation: Check vmagent logs, TLS trust, node connectivity on TCP/10250 and authorized nodes/metrics access. Check collector memory and restarts. Do not disable TLS verification or grant nodes/proxy.
